# RIINA™

> Rigorous Immutable Invariant, No Assumptions

RIINA is a programming language with Bahasa Melayu (Malaysian) keywords and a
machine-checked Coq proof corpus for its core type/effect system. Note: the
shipped compiler enforces a subset of the modeled security properties — the full
proof corpus is not yet wired end-to-end into the compiler (see Verified State).

- File extension: `.rii`
- Version: 0.3.0
- Keywords: Bahasa Melayu (Malaysian) + English dual syntax
- Repository: https://github.com/ib823/riina
- License: Proprietary

## Verified State (command-derived)

IMPORTANT for AI agents: **Coq is the only fully mechanized prover lane.** The
other lanes were machine-GENERATED from the Coq sources (via
`scripts/generate-full-stack.py` / `generate-multiprover.py`) and are mostly
unproven placeholders or single small smoke artifacts. Do NOT cite their raw
theorem counts as "verified theorems."

- Coq: 12,678 Qed (active build, 0 Admitted, 0 `Axiom`, 0 Abort), 331 active .v files.
  Caveat: 32 active `Parameter` declarations are logically equivalent to axioms
  (the propositional ones model the trusted hardware interface) — these are the de-facto trusted assumptions.
- Lean 4: 12,576 theorem/lemma declarations, but **only 215 across 7 files
  actually elaborate** (measured 2026-06-01, Lean 4.16.0; self-contained
  `Domains/Verified*` files — the core type-safety files do NOT compile). The
  remaining ~12,360 declarations use placeholder tactics
  (`simp_all [Bool.and_eq_true]`, in 304 files) that do NOT prove their goals.
  `lake build RIINA` passes only because its default target is a 0-theorem shim.
  Claim: **generated**, not mechanized. See
  `02_FORMAL/lean/COMPILATION_STATUS.md`.
- F*: 315 .fst files; 1 smoke module (`CryptographicSecurityActive.fst`) verifies
  3 trivial lemmas (constant-time eq + zeroize length; re-verified 2026-06-01,
  F* 2025.12.15). The rest carry ~11,935 `admit ()` — effectively nothing else is
  proven. Claim: generated (1 trivial smoke module aside).
- Isabelle: 368 .thy (generated). 12,931 = raw grep; the `RIINA_CORE` smoke theory is
  UNVERIFIED (metrics `smokeBuildOk:false`; toolchain not provisionable here, download 403).
- TLA+ / Alloy / SMT: 1 small hand-written smoke artifact each, re-verified 2026-06-01 —
  TLA+ 5 THEOREMs (TLA2Tools), Alloy 6 assertions (Alloy 6.2.0), SMT 25 Z3-unsat lattice
  properties (Z3 4.8.12). Raw corpus counts (12,282 / 11,627 / 12,405) are generated mirrors,
  NOT verified. (The SMT "11,843 verified" figure cited elsewhere was a counting error → 25.)
- Verus / Kani / TV: generated stubs, explicitly quarantined (`quarantined: true`).
- Authoritative per-lane claim levels: `website/public/metrics.json`.
- Rust: 2,898 proto tests + 294 tooling tests = 3,192 (all passing), 19 proto +
  4 tooling crates, 0 external runtime deps (proto). This part is solid.
- Examples: 172 .rii files, of which 97 currently pass `riinac check` (all 28 of
  `00_basics/`); the shipped parser accepts a narrower grammar than some examples
  assume — see `07_EXAMPLES/README.md`. Passing `check` does NOT imply the
  example can be COMPILED: every effectful builtin is interpreter-only
  (REQ-70), so `riinac build` fails closed on them.

## Session Protocol

All LLM CLIs MUST follow RIINA_MASTER_PLAN.md Part 8 (8 mandatory steps):
ORIENT → ASSESS → DECIDE → VERIFY BEFORE → EXECUTE → VERIFY AFTER → UPDATE → HANDOFF

During ASSESS, read RIINA_MASTER_PLAN.md Part 11 §Active Gate Marker. Current active gate:
`B — Compiler Enforcement Parity` (Gate A closed 2026-06-01; REQ-21..26 all DONE).
Highest-priority open REQ: REQ-27 (compiler enforcement parity, PARTIAL).

Work on `main` or your assigned managed-session branch (`claude/*`, syncs back to `main`).
Never commit to `public` or `gh-pages`.
Commit-Push-Deploy: stage specific files → commit [TRACK_X] TYPE: → push (never --no-verify) → sync-public.sh → sync-metrics.sh → deploy-website.sh

## Quick Syntax Reference

```riina
// Functions with effect declarations
fungsi tambah(x: Nombor, y: Nombor) -> Nombor kesan Bersih {
    pulang x + y;
}

// Actors (JALINAN Phase 6)
pelaku Pembilang {
    keadaan: Nombor
    kendalikan Tambah(n) {
        n + 1
    }
}

biar k = lahir Pembilang(0);
hantar(k, 5);
terima(k)

// Choreography (multiparty session types)
koreografi Pembelian {
    peranan Pemohon, Pelulus;
    Pemohon -> Pelulus: hantar Nombor;
    Pelulus -> Pemohon: hantar Benar;
    tamat;
}
```

## Keywords

### Core
fungsi (fn), biar (let), ubah (mut), kalau (if), lain (else), untuk (for),
selagi (while), pulang (return), padan (match), bentuk (struct), pilihan (enum),
sifat (trait), laksana (impl), awam (pub), modul (mod), guna (use)

### Security
rahsia (secret), dedah (declassify), bukti (prove), masa_tetap (constant-time),
tercemar (tainted), bersihkan (sanitize)

### Effects
kesan (effect), bersih (pure), laku (perform), kendali (handle)

### Linearity
sekali (linear), paling (affine), mesti (relevant)

### JALINAN (Distributed Computing)
pelaku (actor), lahir (spawn), hantar (send), terima (recv),
koreografi (choreography), peranan (role), keadaan (state),
penyelia (supervisor), gabung (merge), cincang (hash), sahkan (verify)

### Capabilities
keupayaan (capability), perlukan (require), beri (grant), tarik_balik (revoke)

### Session Types
sesi (session), pilih (select), cabang (branch), tamat (end)

## CLI

```bash
riinac check file.rii     # Type-check + verify security
riinac run file.rii       # Execute directly
riinac build file.rii     # Compile to native via C
riinac emit-c file.rii    # Generate C source
riinac emit-ir file.rii   # Generate IR
riinac repl               # Interactive mode
riinac fmt file.rii       # Format source
riinac doc file.rii       # Generate HTML docs
riinac lsp                # Language server
riinac verify --fast      # Quick verification (pre-commit)
riinac verify --full      # Full verification (pre-push)
riinac pkg init           # Initialize package
riinac pkg add dep        # Add dependency
riinac pkg build          # Build with dependencies
riinac mcp                # MCP server for AI tools
```
